title: Dinner Lady Tobacco Rich 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Bar Salts Rich Tobacco offers a deep and full-bodied tobacco experience, blending the smooth character of Virginia Tobacco with the robust, smoky essence of classic dark Tobacco. Hints of toasted Nuts and a delicate touch of Cocoa add complexity, creating a warm and satisfying vape with a slightly earthy finish. Part of the Bar Salts collection, Rich Tobacco is designed to replicate the rich, layered flavours often found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures a consistently bold and long-lasting taste while maintaining a smooth and satisfying vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid provides an excellent balance of vapour production and flavour clarity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation delivers a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for use with pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting premium e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their commitment to high-quality ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a trusted choice for vapers.
